# cpanel_notification_preferences (Data Source)

Reads the cPanel account's notification preferences and their localized descriptions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_notification_preferences" "account" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `account` (String) The singleton account identity, always `account`.
- `descriptions` (Map of String) Localized descriptions keyed by notification preference name.
- `preferences` (Map of Boolean) Every notification preference name and whether it is enabled.
